{{Otheruses|Butler}}
{{Quote|I am a techno-service droid, not a butler droid|[[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], to [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]|<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>}}
'''Butler droids''', also known as a '''Gentlebeings' Droid''', were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that were designed to serve [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] organic beings.

==Role==
Butler droids were designed to cater to their owner's every whim. They were endlessly patient and subservient, polite, and cultured. Butler droids were often placed in charge of the droids in a household, supervising [[Cooking droid/Legends|chefbots]], [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning robos]], and [[Auto-chauffeur|chauffeur droids]]. While butler droids were always unfailing civil to their masters and guests, they had a reputation for being snippy with the other droids under their supervision.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==History==
[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], butler droids were extremely popular. [[Noble/Legends|Nobles]] and aristocrats, always looking for the latest fashion or fad to display their wealth, employed butler droids to serve them, often throwing receptions and dinner parties where they could be shown off. Eventually, the interest in butler droids faded amongst the upper classes, and the market for the units followed.<ref name="EGTD" />

By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the only butler droids operational were centuries old. [[ZZ-4Z]], a [[JV-Z1/D butler droid]], had served seventeen successive [[Dean/Legends|Deans]] of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Carida Academy]].<ref name="EGTD" /> [[Wyx]], a [[BII Butler Droid]] operational during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], had faithfully served the [[Treen family]] for generations.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> Several butler droids were stoned to destruction by the [[Red Knights of Life]] in the [[Square of Hopeful Redemption]] on [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]] during the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
